Method of Attack: Malware loader XORIndex with string obfuscation, multi-endpoint C2 rotation, and host profiling to collect system data
Delivers BeaverTail malware that scans for desktop crypto wallet directories and browser extension paths, archives and exfiltrates data to hardcoded IP-based HTTP endpoint
BeaverTail downloads additional payloads such as InvisibleFerret backdoor using filenames like p.zi or p2.zip
Impacted Systems: Systems with crypto wallets and browser extensions
Attack Vector: Malicious npm packages uploaded to npm registry
Use of legitimate infrastructure providers like Vercel for C2
Supply chain attacks targeting developers and individuals
Indicators of Compromise: String constants matching wallet and extension identifiers attributed to BeaverTail
